behavior.name: Hsr Example Behavior
behavior.author: Lotfi El Hafi
behavior.description: Example of a FlexBE behavior for the Toyota HSR (Human Support Robot). The behavior loops between two log messages with a configurable wait time. Robot motion is intentionally not commanded because the open-source 'hsr-project' GitHub repositories do not include a ROS Noetic navigation stack or MoveIt configuration.

param.name: wait_time
param.label: wait_time
param.hint: Sets the wait_time at each position (seconds)
